proxy.name: infath-out-bog-tanfeeth
proxy.description: Routes to different backend paths on a shared Target Server based on the incoming path, gated by a shared OAuth flow, with a service-unavailable fallback.

policies.name: FC-OAuth
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<FlowCallout continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="FC-OAuth">
    <DisplayName>FC-OAuth</DisplayName>
    <SharedFlowBundle>SF-OAuth</SharedFlowBundle>
</FlowCallout>

policies.name: AM-SetGetLookUpURL
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<AssignMessage continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="AM-SetGetLookUpURL">
    <DisplayName>AM-SetGetLookUpURL</DisplayName>
    <AssignVariable>
        <Name>CompletePathUrl</Name>
        <Template>/TanfeethInteg/1.0/api/Lookup/{lookup.typeNormalized}</Template>
    </AssignVariable>
    <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>true</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</AssignMessage>

policies.name: AM-SetGetRequestStatusURL
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<AssignMessage continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="AM-SetGetRequestStatusURL">
    <DisplayName>AM-SetGetRequestStatusURL</DisplayName>
    <AssignVariable>
        <Name>CompletePathUrl</Name>
        <Value>/TanfeethInteg/1.0/api/ExecutionRequest/GetRequestStatus</Value>
    </AssignVariable>
    <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>true</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</AssignMessage>

policies.name: FC-ServiceUnavailable
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<FlowCallout continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="FC-ServiceUnavailable">
    <DisplayName>FC-ServiceUnavailable</DisplayName>
    <SharedFlowBundle>SF-generalErrorHandling</SharedFlowBundle>
</FlowCallout>

policies.name: AM-Set-PathSuffix-url
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<AssignMessage continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="AM-Set-PathSuffix-url">
    <DisplayName>AM-Set-PathSuffix-url</DisplayName>
    <AssignVariable>
        <Name>target.copy.pathsuffix</Name>
        <Value>false</Value>
    </AssignVariable>
    <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>true</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</AssignMessage>

policies.name: EV-LookupType
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<ExtractVariables continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="EV-LookupType">
    <DisplayName>EV-LookupType</DisplayName>
    <Source clearPayload="false">request</Source>
    <URIPath>
        <Pattern ignoreCase="true">/GetLookup/{lookupType}</Pattern>
    </URIPath>
    <VariablePrefix>lookup</VariablePrefix>
    <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>false</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</ExtractVariables>

policies.name: AM-LookupWhitelist
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<AssignMessage continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="AM-LookupWhitelist">
    <DisplayName>AM-LookupWhitelist</DisplayName>
    <AssignVariable>
        <Name>lookup.allowedTypes</Name>
        <Value>|Cities|Countries|Courts|EnforcementTypes|ExecutionClaimResults|ExecutionRequestStatus|IdentityTypes|LicenseSources|Agencies|</Value>
    </AssignVariable>
    <AssignVariable>
        <Name>lookup.typeNormalized</Name>
        <Ref>lookup.lookupType</Ref>
        <Value>NONE</Value>
    </AssignVariable>
    <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>true</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</AssignMessage>

policies.name: RF-InvalidLookupType
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<RaiseFault continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="RF-InvalidLookupType">
    <DisplayName>RF-InvalidLookupType</DisplayName>
    <FaultResponse>
        <Set>
            <StatusCode>400</StatusCode>
            <ReasonPhrase>Bad Request</ReasonPhrase>
            <Headers>
                <Header name="Content-Type">application/json</Header>
            </Headers>
            <Payload contentType="application/json">{
                "error": {
                    "code": "INVALID_LOOKUP_TYPE",
                    "message": "Unsupported lookup type: '{lookup.typeNormalized}'",
                    "allowed": "{lookup.allowedTypes}"
                }
                }
            </Payload>
        </Set>
    </FaultResponse>
    <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>true</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</RaiseFault>

policies.name: EV-RequestNumber
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<ExtractVariables continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="EV-RequestNumber">
    <DisplayName>EV-RequestNumber</DisplayName>
    <Source clearPayload="false">request</Source>
    <JSONPayload>
        <Variable name="requestNumber" type="string">
            <JSONPath>$.requestNumber</JSONPath>
        </Variable>
    </JSONPayload>
    <VariablePrefix>req</VariablePrefix>
    <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>true</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</ExtractVariables>

policies.name: RF-MissingRequestNumber
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<RaiseFault continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="RF-MissingRequestNumber">
    <DisplayName>RF-MissingRequestNumber</DisplayName>
    <FaultResponse>
        <Set>
            <StatusCode>400</StatusCode>
            <ReasonPhrase>Bad Request</ReasonPhrase>
            <Headers>
                <Header name="Content-Type">application/json</Header>
            </Headers>
            <Payload contentType="application/json">{
                "error": {
                    "code": "MISSING_REQUEST_NUMBER",
                    "message": "requestNumber is required and cannot be empty"
                }
                }
            </Payload>
        </Set>
    </FaultResponse>
    <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>true</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</RaiseFault>

policies.name: AM-SetCreateGovAgencyRequestURL
policies.xml:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>
<AssignMessage continueOnError="false" enabled="true" name="AM-SetCreateGovAgencyRequestURL">
    <DisplayName>AM-SetCreateGovAgencyRequestURL</DisplayName>
    <AssignVariable>
        <Name>CompletePathUrl</Name>
        <Template>/TanfeethInteg/1.0/api/ExecutionRequest/CreateGovAgencyRequest</Template>
    </AssignVariable>
    <IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>true</IgnoreUnresolvedVariables>
</AssignMessage>

targets.name: Bog-Tanfeeth-Server
targets.description: Path is resolved from CompletePathUrl, set by whichever conditional flow matched.

flows.name: GetLookUp
flows.description: Routes /service-a/* requests — sets CompletePathUrl before the TargetEndpoint runs.

flows.name: GetRequestStatus
flows.description: Routes /service-b/* requests — sets CompletePathUrl before the TargetEndpoint runs.

flows.name: Default - Service Unavailable
flows.description: No condition — must stay last so it only catches requests that matched none of the routes above.
